description:
Joo-Wan and Seong-Yoon are doing a secret part-time job by manipulating the evidence of their affair. This job has always been a secret cut using Sung-Yoon, and Seong-Yoon, who has a crush on Joo-Wan, decides that it is difficult to do this job anymore. Can the two people who are trying to organize it finish smoothly?
